ratio.description: Aspect ratio: 9:16 vertical for social, 16:9 landscape.

duration_s.description: Total length in seconds after transitions. Beats share it by weight.

beats.description: One entry per scene, in order. Each beat is a short line; every word enters on its own.

id.description: Optional scene id (used in every data-mosio-id). Defaults to the role name; a repeated role gets -2, -3.

role.description: What this beat does in the story; picks the scene template.

text.description: The words on screen, written literally into the scene HTML.

key.description: The word or words of the text to stress with the accent colour. Must occur in the text.

weight.description: Relative screen time of this beat.

style.description: Look: brand colours, type size and motion speed.

brand.description: Brand colours. They are written to shared/tokens.css, so changing one re-renders every scene.

bg.description: Background colour of every scene (--bg in shared/tokens.css).

main.description: Main brand colour: large shapes and the key surface (--main).

accent.description: Accent colour for the one thing that matters on screen: key word, winner bar, price (--accent).

text_on_accent.description: Text colour used on top of the accent colour, for example on a button (--text-on-accent).

font_scale.description: Multiplier on every type size (--type-scale). 1 is the designed size; check `mosio inspect` for overflow above 1.

pacing.description: Speed of the motion inside each scene: calm slows entrances by about 30 percent, brisk speeds them by about 25 percent. Scene lengths do not change.

case.description: Show the text in capitals (CSS only; the HTML keeps the words as typed) or exactly as typed (--text-case).

# kinetic-typography

Short lines of big type. One scene per line, every word lands on its own beat, one accent word per line. Good for a hook, a slogan or a quote sequence, vertical or landscape.

Source: `fixtures/w1-kinetic`, re-authored as one scene per line with CSS animations (no the timeline, no libraries).

## Beats
| role | template | looks like | limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hook`, `payoff` | `scenes/hook.html` | one word per line at display size, a bar draws in above | 4 words |
| `fact`, `step` | `scenes/line.html` | words flow left to right, small running number, rule underneath | 9 words |
| `cta` | `scenes/cta.html` | centred line, accent pill grows under it | 6 words |

A beat has `role`, `text`, optional `key` (the accent word or words, must occur in the text), optional `weight` (`short`, `medium`, `long`, relative screen time) and optional `id` (the scene id; defaults to the role). 2 to 7 beats, 6 to 40 s.

## The controls worth changing first
- `style.brand.accent` and `style.brand.main`: accent word, pill and bar colours (`shared/tokens.css`).
- `style.font_scale` 0.6 to 1.25: type size. Above 1 check `mosio inspect` for overflow, especially on long words in 9:16.
- `style.pacing` `calm | medium | brisk`: how fast words enter. Scene lengths do not change.
- `style.case` `upper | as-typed`: capitals are CSS only; the HTML keeps your words.

## Taste
- One idea per line. Three to five words read in time; the template refuses more.
- Stress one word per line, never two unrelated ones. The accent colour is the only emphasis.
- Give the last beat `weight: long` so the final line holds still.
- Keep headlines at 64 px or more (the defaults are 104 to 150 px).

## After applying
The result is an ordinary Mosio project: edit words in place, change a brand token in `shared/tokens.css` and only the scenes that import it re-render.

# Kinetic typography: beat plan

Length 6 to 40 s (default 12). Roles: hook, fact, step, payoff, cta; 2 to 7 beats.
Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.6, medium 2.4, long 3.2.

## hook / payoff

- scene: scenes/hook.html
- technique: one word per line at display size, accent word and a bar that draws in
- primitives: rise-fade, bar-draw
- limits: {"max_words": 4}

## fact / step

- scene: scenes/line.html
- technique: words flow left to right on wrapped lines with a running scene number
- primitives: rise-fade
- limits: {"max_words": 9}

## cta

- scene: scenes/cta.html
- technique: centred words, accent pill that grows under the whole line
- primitives: rise-fade, pill-grow
- limits: {"max_words": 6}

## Controls

- Accent colour (`/style/brand/accent`): Recolours the accent word, bar and pill: --accent in shared/tokens.css, so every scene re-renders.
- Type size (`/style/font_scale`): Scales all type: --type-scale in shared/tokens.css.
- Pacing (`/style/pacing`): Speeds or slows each word's entrance: --pace in shared/tokens.css.
- Line text (`/content/beats/0/text`): Edit the words of one beat directly in its scene file; only that scene re-renders.
